items.reasons: Reject. (1) Earlier end not excluded: EO 11540 (held; 'This order shall be effective July 1, 1970') removed the words EO 11367 inserted in EO 11248 sec. 1 item (5) and substituted 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget'. Whether that is a retitle of the same office (so the clause runs to EO 11708, 1973-03-23) or the end of the EO 11367 placement on 1970-07-01 turns on whether the 'Assistant Director for Executive Management' was one of the statutory Assistant Director offices (31 U.S.C. 16a, 16c) that Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 sec. 102(b) redesignates. The held plan does not name the post and does not say which offices were statutory; non-statutory officers fall under sec. 102(c) (new Level V officers with titles set by the Director), not 102(b). The producer's 'live object under sec. 102(b)' and 'widened, not withdrawn' reading assumes the missing fact. The brief allows a partial find to be submitted only if the held plan alone decides the clause; it does not, and the OMB organization record (FETCH line 252) is still not held. Craigellachie 03's reviewer named the same dependency. (2) The binding lesson 'the quote must contain the mechanism and the date' is not met: the first_end quote is the EO 11708 sec. 3 sentence only; 'March 23, 1973' is outside the quoted span (producer flagged this). The EO 11708 sec. 3 revocation itself is correctly read: no effective-date wording, sec. 2 continues only eight level V positions, item (5) is level IV, and sec. 1(9) is a new placement; savings reading (none) holds. Outcome should be blocked, not upheld.
